title: Seacrest Beach "Casa Bella" 8045 E County Hwy 30A
h1: Seacrest Beach "Casa Bella" 8045 E County Hwy 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Rooftop wrap-around balcony, you will have a 360-degree view of the Gulf- Private heated pool **Pool heat available October 1-May 1 for $40 per day** - Air hockey- 5 adult bikes- 1 Mile away from The Big Chill- A Local Hangout with Restaurants, Dining and Shopping- 2 Miles away from Rosemary Beach Town Center- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Escape to Casa Bella, a stunning Gulf-view retreat in peaceful Seacrest Beach along Scenic 30A. This spacious 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom with 2 half-baths haven sleeps up to 18 guests, offering the perfect getaway for friends and family. With 3,500 square feet of living space, guests will love the air hockey table, pristine private pool, and wraparound rooftop balcony with 360-degree views of the Gulf—all within steps of beach access, located directly across the street.With a cozy entertainment room on the first floor featuring a large TV and direct access to a magnificent private pool and deck area, guests are sure to spend quality time together. Each beautifully decorated guest bedroom offers supreme comfort, with a king bed and private bathroom in one and a queen bed in another. The bunk room boasts 1 twin-over-twin and 1 queen-over-queen bed, perfect for kids. There's a comfortable queen sleeper sofa on this floor for last-minute guests and a washer and dryer for convenience.The second floor is the heart of this 3-story home, where comfort and sophistication meet. Lounge on plush furnishings in front of the large TV while catching up on the latest news or beloved shows before enjoying delightful homemade meals and board games at the spacious dining table. The kitchen, featuring a breakfast bar that seats 4, is ready to whip tasty snacks and meals. Step onto the covered porches and be swept away by the breathtaking views of Scenic 30A and the Gulf of Mexico. Perfect for families, the guest bedroom offers a king bed, twin bed, twin trundle bed, and a private bathroom with a spacious soaking tub.Experience luxury and privacy on the third floor, where a stunning guest bedroom boasts a queen bed, convenient half bath, and stylish kitchenette. But that's not all—step onto the wraparound balcony and prepare to be blown away by the breathtaking 360-degree views of the gorgeous scenery and sparkling emerald waters.Experience the ultimate beach getaway at Casa Bella! Relax by the pool, take leisurely strolls to Gulf Lakes for beach access, and set off on 5 complimentary adult bikes to discover the charming communities of Alys Beach, Seaside, and Seagrove Beach. Browse through delightful shops along 30A in the afternoon and start making unforgettable memories today! Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 18):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Twin-over-Twin and Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Twin bed and Twin Trundle Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Half Bathroom with Wrap around Porch and Kitchenette
